did.unittitle: Ford Foundation records, Office of Communications, Office Files of Carolee Iltis

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection contains the office files Carolee Iltis created and maintained when she worked in various positions in the Ford Foundation's Office of Reports and Office of Communications. The files span across Iltis' full tenure at the Ford Foundation, including her positions as Assistant Administrative Officer and then Distribution Manager in the Office of Reports and later as Distribution Manager and then Manager for Dissemination and Administration in the Office of Communications. The Office of Reports was restructured into the Office of Communications.

The collection is comprised of two series. The first series, a set of work files, contains the bulk of the collection. Most of the work files document Iltis managing the distribution of individual publications. The second series contains a small run of Iltis' chronology files.

In managing the dissemination of the Ford Foundation's published works, Iltis ensured that the publications were sent to media representatives and other selected individuals and institutions, responded to requests for copies and reprints, handled copyright certification, and monitored and communicated about when the publications were out of print.
Common material formats in the collection include correspondence, publication copies, invoices, purchase orders, distribution notes, mailing lists, and drafts.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Ford Foundation archive was deposited at the RAC in 2011. Ford Foundation records, correspondence, reports, program files, and officers' papers were transferred to and accessioned by the RAC beginning in 2011. Accessions continue as necessary.
This material was transferred to the RAC in three accessions between 2019 and 2022 and was ingested by the RAC as Accessions 2019:086, 2021:138, and 2022:034.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Ford Foundation has title, copyright and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them.

The Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish material from the collection. Permission to publish extensive excerpts, or material in its entirety, will be referred to the Ford Foundation.

did.unittitle: Work files

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This series contains work files Carolee Iltis created and maintained when she worked in the Ford Foundation's Office of Reports and Office of Communications. Almost all of the files in the series correspond to the titles of publications Iltis and her office disseminated. Job numbers are assigned to most of the files.

Publications represented in the series are usually Ford Foundation original reports, reports reprinted by the Foundation from other publications, overviews of Foundation program activities, issues of the Ford Foundation Annual Report, issues of the Foundation newsletter, The Letter, and guides to films funded by the Foundation. Many of the publications are in the form of booklets.

The files document the different processes and activities Iltis managed for distributing the publications including labeling, mailing, reprints, working with consultants, and copyright. Files often include distribution notes and slips describing the job.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This series contains a run of chronology files Carolee Iltis created and maintained when she served as Manager for Dissemination and Administration of the Ford Foundation's Office of Communications. The series only includes chronology files from the year 1998.

The chronology files contain Iltis' correspondence. The correspondence documents Iltis' managing the distribution of the Foundation's published works and communications which included activities like labeling, mailing, copyright registration, and reprints. Some pieces also discuss the Office of Communication's budget and internal Foundation policies.
